description.p: Solstice is a digital audio workstation for GNOME. Its tracks area, inspector, library, mixer and editors follow the layout and keyboard shortcuts of professional studio software.

ul.li: Audio and software instrument tracks with low-latency input monitoring
VST3 and CLAP plug-ins, plus built-in effects, instruments and MIDI effects
Aux buses, sends, VCA faders, side-chains and plug-in delay compensation
Piano roll, step sequencer, Event List and automation
Cycle recording into take folders with swipe comping
Tempo and signature changes, arrangement sections and markers
Real-time bounce, track export and bounce in place
